entities.name: Nissa Revane
entities.description: An elf Planeswalker who keeps vigil for Zendikar's lost soul, helps Munda find a goblin, and realizes Zendikar may be at Khalni Heart; she planeswalks to Bala Ged.

entities.name: Munda
entities.description: A kor squad leader in Gideon's army with glowing hedron tattoos who tracks a lost goblin.

entities.name: Pili
entities.description: An injured goblin recruit who insists her friend Leek is still alive.

entities.name: Leek
entities.description: Pili's goblin friend, found dead in a cave-in.

entities.name: Gideon Jura
entities.description: The Planeswalker commanding an army at Sky Rock to retake Sea Gate.

entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: A Planeswalker who was curious about Nissa's perception of the world.

entities.name: Ashaya
entities.description: Nissa's elemental friend, manifestation of Zendikar's soul, who vanished.

entities.name: Zendikar
entities.description: The plane whose soul was torn from Nissa and which she now seeks.

entities.name: Eldrazi
entities.description: The monsters Nissa blames for taking Zendikar's soul.

entities.name: The seeds
entities.description: Seeds from trees wiped out by the Eldrazi, given to Nissa by a vampire as the world's last hope.

entities.name: Khalni Heart
entities.description: The place where all of Zendikar's leylines converge, expression of its mana.

entities.name: Bala Ged
entities.description: Nissa's homeland where she first met the world's soul, and her destination.

entities.name: Sky Rock
entities.description: The floating hedron camp where Gideon amasses his army.

entities.name: Sea Gate
entities.description: The fallen city Gideon plans to reclaim.

entities.name: The Vastwood Forest
entities.description: The forest where Nissa keeps vigil.

entities.name: The Dojir Nomads
entities.description: Recruits from the Calcite Flats who joined Gideon's army.

entities.name: The leylines
entities.description: The network of power connecting every living thing on Zendikar that Nissa can no longer perceive.

events.summary: Nissa keeps vigil each twilight at the bluff where Zendikar was torn from her, finding only emptiness.
events.quote: She kept vigil there, returning each day to ground herself

events.summary: Nissa recalls that Gideon and Jace did not understand her account of Zendikar's lost soul.
events.quote: She had told them that something horrible had happened to Zendikar's soul.

events.summary: A fleeing goblin warns Nissa of a swarm of Eldrazi, and Nissa fights them with only her sword to protect the clearing.
events.quote: She stepped forward to stand between the precious piece of land and the monsters.

events.summary: Nissa nearly planeswalks away from the swarm but refuses because it would mean it was over.
events.quote: But leaving would mean that it was over.

events.summary: Munda arrives and helps kill the swarm, and Nissa joins him in tracking the goblin.
events.quote: a hook on a chain rushed past her and plunged into one of the Eldrazi

events.summary: Munda tells Nissa about Gideon's army and his plan to retake Sea Gate; Nissa silently disagrees with 'taking back' Zendikar.
events.quote: As one, we'll reclaim Sea Gate.

events.summary: Nissa and Munda find Pili at a hidden cave where a group of goblins is trapped, and free them; Leek is dead.
events.quote: Three bodies were lined up against the wall.

events.summary: Pili grieves for Leek, and Nissa comforts her.
events.quote: Nissa had never hugged a goblin before.

events.summary: Pili's insistence that she knew inspires Nissa to realize Zendikar's soul may have retreated to Khalni Heart.
events.quote: If something had happened, if the titan had threatened the world's soul, that's where it would have run to.

events.summary: Nissa slips away from the goblins and planeswalks to Bala Ged to find Zendikar.
events.quote: Nissa planeswalked away—back home, back to Bala Ged, to find Zendikar.

relations.quote: She would always be there for her friend.

relations.note: A squad leader in Gideon's army.
relations.quote: I'm Munda, one of Gideon's squad leaders.

relations.note: Fought alongside him before Sea Gate fell.
relations.quote: We battled together, Gideon and me

relations.note: Blames them for the loss of Zendikar's soul.
relations.quote: All of the pain and destruction here, it was all their fault.

relations.note: The convergence point of Zendikar's leylines.
relations.quote: The spot where all the leylines converged.
